name: legacy-transition
title_zh: MDD 证书过期前，你还能卖到哪一天
tagline_zh: 手里还攥着 MDD 证书、库存压在仓库、客户催着要 CE 有效期？
tagline_en: Still holding an MDD certificate with stock in the warehouse? It applies MDR Article 120 as amended by 2023/607.
desc_en: Answer whether a legacy medical device can still be placed on the EU market under MDR Article 120 as amended by Regulation (EU) 2023/607, and by when. Use when the user asks "how long can we keep selling", "MDR transition deadline", "Article 120", "legacy device", "our MDD certificate", "do we still have until 2024", "extension", or describes a device certified under 90/385/EEC or 93/42/EEC.
why_zh: 不背条文，直接对着你的证书类型、签发日期和器械分类套 2023/607 的分档延期表。
why_en: It skips the legalese and maps your certificate type, issue date and device class onto the 2023/607 tiered extension table.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 90/385/EEC 和 93/42/EEC 下已获证书的 legacy 器械；MDR 新认证、IVDR。
limit_en: Only legacy devices certified under 90/385/EEC or 93/42/EEC. Not for new MDR certifications, IVDR, combination products, or already-expired MDD.
title_en: How long can your legacy device stay on the EU market?
